scope: Only freeze-v3 to freeze-v4 target-refresh delta and original failure provenance reviewed; no new GUI/test/build or source edits. Full source review remains code-review-v1. Current worktree has advanced to v5; this report binds the archived v4 source and does not claim current working JS equals v4.

findings.title: Reobserve native-session target after service restart
findings.issue: live-v1 reused baselineTarget from the previous ACC/native worker. prepare_recording rejected target_stale before reaching the intended live-registry tool_unavailable test.
findings.resolution: The hidden service now calls actual list_windows, selects the same owned receiver PID and ready window handle, requires a nonempty native ref, and uses that fresh target for both saved recording and nested batch. Saved recording and event bytes remain unchanged; the batch creates a new args object, overriding target after the sequence spread.

sourceBasis: prepare_recording uses the same macos_session.request before macro_run checks the live _tool_map
Native ObserveWindow retains refs in worker-local bindings and CheckTarget returns target_stale for refs missing from that worker
contractAssessment.ownership: Added read-only query remains restricted to the existing owned receiver PID/window. Empty or absent ref triggers check and exits to finally before the macro call. It does not focus or input into any new target.
contractAssessment.expectedError: tool_unavailable is still required after correct target preflight; nested batch still requires failed1/completed0 and unknown/non-batchable error. No expected-code loosening.
contractAssessment.otherCases: Missing helper fails before native target validation; master-off host policy refuses before target dispatch. Their use of baselineTarget is therefore unchanged and intentional.
contractAssessment.cleanup: No environment, process, recording file, receiver or service-cleanup logic changes in this delta. Prior R1/R2 stay closed.
contractAssessment.limit: v4 still uses pure unpressed move: receiver counts alone cannot observe a repeated same-point move; prior review already limits no-input evidence to registry/error/audit plus counts. Parent plans separate v5 balanced-click observability review. This report approves only the target-refresh delta and supplies no full-candidate runtime acceptance.

originalFailureEvidence.interpretation: Failed development freeze-v3 attempt. Baseline/missing-helper checks and actual hidden-registry removal passed; hidden replay stopped at target_stale. Two FAIL lines are the mismatch and its fail-fast exception. Nested batch and both master-off cases were not reached. Original failure remains intact, with no product-defect attribution.
